name: Buona Forchetta
menu_notes: Official site (buonaforchettasd.com) and its Toast ordering page (source_url) render menus client-side and could not be fetched directly (Toast returned 403). Cross-checked via aggregated web search results instead: Margherita $18, Juna $22, Bolognese (pasta) $23, Burrata Caprese $18, Montanara $14, Artichokes $20, Calamari Fritti $19, Eggplant Tortino $15 and Polpettine $16 all matched name, description and price. No mismatches found in what could be verified.
data_notes: Address 3001 Beech St, San Diego, CA 92102 and South Park neighborhood confirmed correct via multiple sources. Hours mostly match (Mon-Thu dinner 5-9:30pm and Sun 12-9:30pm continuous both confirmed) but DB shows Friday as one continuous 1200-2200 block while independent listings describe Friday as split lunch 12-3 / dinner 5-10pm (a lunch-dinner gap), so the Friday hours may be slightly wrong. Cuisine 'Pizza' is a reasonable simplification of what is really a full Italian menu.
issues: Friday hours in DB (continuous 1200-2200) may be missing a 3-5pm gap that other sources show

source_url's Toast slug references a '252 N El Camino Real Ste 5' address that does not match the restaurant's real address (3001 Beech St); menu content still checked out fine but the slug itself looks mismatched/leftover from another location
